text:
rachel: Heads up 10: customer quickstart (edge-template) started failing after we landed the new package exports change in sdk@2.3.x. They reported a hard crash during Vercel build: `Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: Must use import to load ES Module` coming from a `require('redwood-inference')` call.

ci-bot: CI failure: samples/quickstarts/edge-template  job 98 failed  bundle step. Error snippet: `RollupError: Could not resolve 'redwood-inference' from src/index.js` then downstream `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`.

tom: Reproduced locally with `vercel dev`. The issue is our conditional exports map now favors the ESM branch without a worker/edge explicit condition. Many bundlers (esbuild/vite/rollup when targeting edge) will pick the ESM entry, but legacy sample code that uses CommonJS `require()` hits the ESM build at runtime and Node throws.

jin: Also noticed TS picking up the ESM d.ts path which exposes `export default`, but our CJS consumers expect `module.exports =` shape. Downstream TS projects get `RI.default` surprises. We never added conditional `types` or `typesVersions` to help consumers.

alex: Quick theory: some packagers look for `main` and `module` fields if `exports` is present but ambiguous. If `main` points at a CJS entry as a fallback, older tooling will behave better. Maybe add `main: './dist/cjs/index.js'` and `module: './dist/esm/index.js'` alongside the `exports` map. That keeps backward compatibility for older bundlers.

rachel: We need two things: 1) stop new installs from regressing existing quickstarts, 2) provide a clear migration for edge-first users. Which fix is least risky for a patch?

jin: Low-risk patch: add an explicit `./edge` subpath export and a `worker` condition. E.g.:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "worker": "./dist/edge/esm/index.js",
    "default": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./edge": "./dist/edge/esm/index.js",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Plus add `main`/`module` fields and conditional `types` mapping.

tom: Quick note: "default" is not spec-mandated but used by some bundlers as a fallback. Also some environments (deno/edge) expect an explicit `deno` or `worker` condition. We should test against: Vercel Edge (esbuild), Cloudflare Workers (wrangler), Bun, and node 14/16/18 for CJS compatibility.

alex: For TypeScript, add `typesVersions` and `exports` types condition: `"types": { "worker": "dist/edge/index.d.ts", "default": "dist/cjs/index.d.ts" }` and add `typesVersions` to support older TS that doesn't respect conditional types. Or add `index.cjs.d.ts` and `index.mjs.d.ts` and reference them in `typesVersions` mapping.

rachel: Migration docs: update quickstarts to prefer `import` for edge templates and add explicit examples using `import RI from 'redwood-inference/edge'`. For CJS quickstarts keep a defensive pattern: `const RI = require('redwood-inference').default || require('redwood-inference')` with a comment linking to migration guide.

ci-bot: Issue created #4021  "edge exports: require/import fallback + types" assigned to tom.

tom: Plan: open a patch PR that does 1) add `./edge` subpath export, 2) add `worker` condition that points to edge ESM, 3) add `main` and `module` fields for legacy bundlers, 4) add conditional `types` and `typesVersions`, 5) add smoke tests in CI matrix: vercel, wrangler, node-cjs, bun. PR will include tests that run `node -e "console.log(require('redwood-inference').version)"` and `node --input-type=module -e "import('redwood-inference').then(m=>console.log(m.version))"` and a vercel dev build.

jin: Also propose a small runtime shim in `dist/cjs/index.js` that normalizes exports so `module.exports = exports.default || exports` to reduce friction for mixed consumers. That is a safe runtime change and avoids some `.default` woes.

alex: We should also add a section to the changelog and a short support template for agents to copy/paste: steps to triage (check package.json exports, try `import` vs `require`, suggest `/edge` subpath or patch version).

rachel: Sounds good. Prioritize the patch and tests. After merge, we push a patch release and update quickstart PRs to use explicit `/edge` imports and update READMEs. Also notify support with a canned response.

tom: Opening PR now. ETA: same-day for draft, run CI, merge if green. I'll ping once green to trigger a patch release.

rachel: Thanks all. Follow-up: jin, can you prepare the typesVersions snippet? alex, can you coordinate the quickstart updates? I'll own the changelog + support note.

jin: On it  will post snippet in the PR.

alex: I'll start PRs against samples/quickstarts.

ci-bot: PR #789 opened by tom: "hotfix: exports + types for edge compatibility". CI: queued.
